mechanism_narrative: A sustained 5-month decline in the real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 rises by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter in the subsequent 3 months, or if S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals labor market weakness, which reduces corporate profit margins and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE falls below 4.0% in the subsequent 2 months, or if S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 100 signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises above 102 in the subsequent 3 months, or if S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below 1300 signals weakening residential construction activity, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST rises above 1400 in the subsequent 2 months, or if S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 5.5% signals monetary tightening, which increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows and depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS falls below 5.0% in the subsequent 2 months, or if S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances.
